name: Ronopoly
desc:
A Roblox themed real-estate game where you go around the board buying various popular Roblox games adding servers to them to increase landing fees. 

In this game you can win by getting three monopolies {a group of same colored games}, a full side of the board, all of the Tycoons or forcing all other players into bankruptcy.



Message to Developers:

Ronopoly depicts some of the most famous games on Roblox. We hope you're happy with your game being on the board, if not please get in touch.
